title: Why Drain Traps Lose Their Water Seal
description: Sewer gas entering a building is frequently caused by a dry P-trap. When a plumbing fixture drains without adequate atmospheric venting, the fast-flowing water creates negative air pressure in the pipe behind it. This suction actively pulls the protective water seal out of the trap, a process known as self-siphoning. Without this liquid barrier, foul odors freely enter the living space. Understanding the balance between fluid movement and air pressure venting is crucial for identifying the root cause of persistent drainage smells.
